summary: Verified all 24 estimates against the paper and extraction rules after reading the complete markdown conversion, including references and Appendices A-H. Checked every cited numerical source directly in the PDF and checked the study design, scoring rubric, analysis units, coding, and outcome coverage. The five recorded net advantages, three FIERO win percentages, three chi-squared statistics and their p-value bounds, and all 81-pair denominators match the printed results and the correct judges and outcomes. The 60-person study and 30-person questionnaire arm counts are not substituted for the unreported participant counts of the nine-story-per-arm evaluation corpus. Values available only in figures, unassigned range endpoints, and unreported uncertainty correctly remain null. The overall-comparison tests are kept separate from the dimension-level results, and their uncertainty is correctly coded at the pair level. No missing eligible outcome or contrast was found; the questionnaire self-reports and qualitative observations are appropriately excluded.
